Aberrant Sorcery

subclass

Acolyte

background

D&D 5e 2024 Acolyte background — Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma; Magic Initiate (Cleric) feat; Insight and Religion proficiencies.

Arcane Trickster

subclass

Rogue subclass (PHB 2024) — adds INT spellcasting to the Rogue; Mage Hand Legerdemain, True Strike for weapon-based INT builds, Arcane Deflection.

Artificer

class

D&D 5e 2024 Artificer — half caster, master of magic items and tools, Replicate Magic Item is the signature feature.

Artisan

background

D&D 5e 2024 Artisan background — Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence; Crafter feat; Investigation and Persuasion proficiencies.

Assassin

subclass

Rogue subclass (PHB 2024) — focused on massive turn-1 damage; Assassinate rewards going first in initiative with bonus damage and guaranteed Sneak Attack.

Barbarian

class

D&D 5e 2024 Barbarian — martial class with Rage for damage resistance and bonus damage; Constitution-heavy, front-line fighter.

Bard

class

D&D 5e 2024 Bard — full CHA caster with Bardic Inspiration, Expertise, and Jack of All Trades; Perrin Black-Jaw is Bard/Warlock.

Bastions

subsystem

2024 rules for player-owned strongholds; characters gain a Bastion at level 5 and issue orders to its special facilities every 7 in-game days.

Battle Master

subclass

Fighter subclass (PHB 2024) — tactical combat maneuvers using Superiority Dice; the most mechanically flexible Fighter subclass; Stripes Bitemore is a Battle Master.

encounter-design

Pointy Hat's system for dynamic boss fights: the boss telegraphs a threat at end of its turn, players have a full round to neutralize or mitigate it before resolution.

subclass

Ranger subclass (PHB 2024) — commands a Primal Companion beast that scales with WIS; both Striker and Defender; bypass Hunter's Mark in multi-target encounters.

condition

Carouser

background

D&D 5e 2024 Carouser background — Dexterity, Intelligence, Charisma; Tireless Reveler feat; Deception and Persuasion proficiencies.

facility

Charlatan

background

D&D 5e 2024 Charlatan background — Dexterity, Constitution, Charisma; Skilled feat; Deception and Sleight of Hand proficiencies.

Charmed

condition

Charmed condition — can't attack or target the charmer with harm; the charmer has Advantage on social ability checks against you.

facility

Ship facility (Library Tier 1) that lets a hireling research a topic over 7 days and return up to three previously unknown facts.

rule

2024 system for combining multiple spellcasters to empower a single spell via Augment, Distribute, Expand, or Prolong options; no resource cost beyond spell slots and actions.

subclass

Sorcerer subclass (PHB 2024) — orderly, reroll-focused magic; Restore Balance flips advantage/disadvantage on saves; Trance of Order guarantees minimum 10 on d20s.

subclass

Bard subclass (Tasha's Cauldron 2020) — masters of rhetoric; Bardic Inspiration dice can't be wasted on low rolls; Unsettling Words imposes Disadvantage on one save; Perrin Black-Jaw uses this subclass.

College Of Valor

subclass

Bard subclass (PHB 2024) — martial Bard with Medium armor, Martial weapons, Combat Inspiration for offense/defense, and Extra Attack at Level 6.

facility

condition

Draconic Sorcery

subclass

Sorcerer subclass (PHB 2024) — draconic power grants AC bonus, HP boost, elemental resistance and damage bonus, Dragon Wings at 14, Dragon Companion at 18; the generalist Sorcerer.

Druid

class

D&D 5e 2024 Druid — WIS-based primal full caster with Wild Shape, nature magic, and strong control/healing options.

Entertainer

background

D&D 5e 2024 Entertainer background — Strength, Dexterity, Charisma; Musician feat; Acrobatics and Performance proficiencies.

Exhaustion

condition

Exhaustion condition — stacking levels (1-6); each level reduces D20 Tests by 2 and speed by 5 ft; level 6 is death; 1 level removed per Long Rest.

class

D&D 5e 2024 Fighter — all armor, Action Surge, Extra Attack scaling; Stripes Bitemore is a Battle Master Fighter.

condition

condition

Grappled condition — Speed 0; Disadvantage on attacks against anyone other than the grappler; grappler can move you at cost of 1 extra foot per foot moved.

subclass

Warlock subclass (PHB 2024) — alien patron grants telepathy, aberration knowledge, Entropic Ward, and eventually Devouring Blade; Perrin Black-Jaw is a Great Old One Warlock.

Hexblade

subclass

Warlock subclass (XGtE 2014) — CHA-based weapon attacks, Medium armor, Hexblade's Curse for bonus damage and self-healing; strong melee Warlock foundation.

Hunter Ranger

subclass

Ranger subclass (PHB 2024) — the iconic Ranger; mostly passive features with Hunter's Lore, Hunter's Prey options, and Superior Hunter's Defense. Accessible but low ceiling.

condition

Incapacitated condition — can't take actions or reactions, Concentration broken, can't speak; Disadvantage on Initiative if Incapacitated when rolling.

Invisible

condition

Invisible condition — Advantage on attacks and Initiative; Disadvantage on attacks against you; concealed from sight-based effects.

Merchant

background

D&D 5e 2024 Merchant background — Constitution, Intelligence, Charisma; Lucky feat; Animal Handling and Persuasion proficiencies.

Monk

class

D&D 5e 2024 Monk — DEX+WIS unarmored class with Martial Arts, Focus Points, and Stunning Strike; Crissdalynn Khinriss is a Kensei Monk.

rule

Paladin

class

D&D 5e 2024 Paladin — CHA-based half caster with Divine Smite, heavy armor, Auras, and Lay on Hands.

Paralyzed

condition

Paralyzed condition — Incapacitated, Speed 0, auto-fail STR/DEX saves, attacks against you have Advantage, and any hit by an attacker within 5 ft is a Critical Hit.

Petrified

condition

Petrified condition — transformed into inanimate stone; Incapacitated, Speed 0, Resistance all damage, Immunity Poisoned, Advantage on attacks against you, auto-fail STR/DEX saves.

Poisoned

condition

Poisoned condition — Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

Prone

condition

Prone condition — only movement option is to crawl or spend half Speed to stand; Disadvantage on attacks; attacks against you have Advantage within 5 ft, Disadvantage otherwise.

Swashbuckler

subclass

Rogue subclass (XGtE 2014) — CHA-based Rogue for duelists and pirates; Fancy Footwork prevents opportunity attacks after melee strikes; Sneak Attack without an ally nearby; Delmar Fisk is a Swashbuckler.

Thief

subclass

Rogue subclass (PHB 2024) — iconic Scout Rogue; Fast Hands grants Bonus Action use of magic items; High Jump and Reliable Talent round out a skill-focused build.

condition

Unconscious condition — Incapacitated and Prone, Speed 0, Advantage on attacks against you, auto-fail STR/DEX saves, any hit within 5 ft is a Critical Hit, unaware of surroundings.

active
rule

Tier 1 bastion facility — Sanctuary adapted for the ship. Grants a weekly Healing Word charm and supports crafting of holy symbols or druidic focuses.

Way Of Mercy

subclass

Monk subclass (PHB 2024) — combat medic; Hand of Harm adds necrotic damage, Hand of Healing provides action-economic healing, Hand of Ultimate Mercy resurrects at Level 17.

Way Of Shadow

subclass

Monk subclass (PHB 2024) — darkness-powered striker; Shadow Arts (1 FP) casts Darkness for permanent Advantage; Shadow Step teleports in dim light/darkness; Cloak of Shadows grants free Flurry.

Way Of The Elements

subclass

Monk subclass (PHB 2024) — 10-foot reach, elemental damage type switching, vertical knockback for falling damage, flight at Level 11 via Stride of the Elements.

Way Of The Kensei

subclass

Monk subclass (XGtE 2014) — weapons as extensions of the body; Kensei weapons, Agile Parry (+2 AC), Sharpen the Blade (+1/2/3 to attacks/damage), Unerring Accuracy; Crissdalynn Khinriss uses this subclass.

Way Of The Open Hand

subclass

Monk subclass (PHB 2024) — the classic Monk; Open Hand Technique adds push/prone/reaction-strip to Flurry of Blows; Fleet Step for free Dash; Quivering Palm 10d12 finisher at L11.

Weapons Locker

active
rule

Tier 1 bastion facility — stocking it upgrades defender death dice from d6 to d8 for one Bastion Turn. Cost halved if the ship also has a Carpenter's Shop.

Wild Magic Sorcery

subclass

Sorcerer subclass (PHB 2024) — chaotic magic; Tides of Chaos for Advantage, Bend Luck for ally/enemy roll manipulation (2 SP), Controlled Chaos doubles surge table results; lacks a prepared spell list.

Winter Walker

subclass

Ranger subclass (Forgotten Realms Heroes of Faerun 2024) — cold damage specialist; Polar Strikes adds WIS to cold rolls; Frozen Haunt at L11 grants cold immunity and partial incorporeality.

Wizard

class
